About the College
Adhiparasakthi Agricultural College is a premier institution dedicated to advancing agricultural education, research, and rural development. Established with the noble vision of empowering society through quality education, the college stands as a centre of excellence committed to nurturing skilled, knowledgeable, and ethically grounded agricultural professionals.
Located in a serene and eco-friendly environment, the college provides students with a blend of academic strength, practical exposure, modern laboratories, and extensive farm facilities. The curriculum is carefully designed to meet global agricultural challenges, encourage innovation, and build confidence among students to become successful agri-professionals, researchers, entrepreneurs, and service-oriented leaders.
The institution places strong emphasis on value-based education, integrating academic knowledge with character formation, social responsibility, and spiritual enrichment, thereby preparing students to contribute meaningfully to the farming community and society at large.
